summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $4.41/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $4.41 a gallon across Wisconsin as of October 26, 2026, according to GasBuddy. AAA figures put the statewide average 32¢ higher than a week ago, 18¢ higher than a month ago, and $1.71 higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Eau Claire ($4.08) and the highest in Mosinee ($4.69).
